info.title: Talyn API
info.description: Start and drive Talyn sessions from code. Authenticate with a personal access token. See docs/PUBLIC_API.md for the guides.

bearerAuth.description: A personal access token (`talyn_pat_...`) from Settings → Developer in the Talyn app.

param.description: The request field the error is about, when there is one.

error.description: Some errors carry more fields, e.g. `limit` and `in_use` on a plan limit.

workspace_ids.description: The workspaces this token can reach. Null: all of them.

next_cursor.description: Pass as `cursor` for the next page. Null on the last page.
Pass as `cursor` for the next page. Null on the last page.

queued_message_count.description: Messages waiting for the running turn to end.

thread_id.description: The thread this session belongs to, if any.

runtime.description: A `local` session runs in the desktop app. The API lists it read-only; actions on it answer 409 `local_runtime`.

diff_stat.description: Null until a diff has been computed once.

chats.description: The open chats, oldest first. On single-session responses only.

next_cursor.description: Pass as `cursor` for the next page. Null on the last page.

workspace_id.description: Required unless the token is bound to exactly one workspace.

kind.description: Default `session`. A thread takes no repository or branch.

prompt.description: The first message. The agent starts on it when the sandbox is ready.

name.description: Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens. Default: made from the prompt.

branch.description: An existing branch to work on. Default: a new branch.

pull_request_id.description: Start from this pull request's head branch and link the session to it.

thread_id.description: Put the new session in this thread.

queued.description: True: the message waits behind a running turn or for the sandbox. False: the turn started now.

seq.description: Position in the chat. Gap-free and increasing.

data.description: The agent event, in Claude Code's stream-json format. Codex output is converted to the same format. New fields can appear.

has_more.description: More events exist in the direction you paged.

last_seq.description: Pass as `after` for the next page forward.

get.summary: Get the token and its owner
get.description:
Returns the token that made the request: its scopes, its workspace binding and its expiry, and the account it acts for.

Any valid token.

X-Request-Id.description: The id of this request. Also in every error body.

400.description: The request is not valid. `error.param` names the field.

401.description: The token is missing, not valid, expired or revoked.

403.description: The token lacks the scope, or the API or sessions are not available for this account.

404.description: No such resource, or the token cannot reach it.

500.description: A fault on our side. Quote `error.request_id`.

post.description:
Creates a sandbox session on a repository (or a thread, with `kind: "thread"`) and starts provisioning. With a `prompt`, the agent starts on it when the sandbox is ready. Counts against the plan like a session started in the app.

Scope: `sessions:write`.

schema.description: Send the same key when you retry, and the request runs once. Kept for 24 hours.

get.description:
Server-sent events: `session.updated` when the session changes, `chat.updated` when one of its chats changes, and `end` when the session is deleted. Frames have no ids: on reconnect, read the session again. A comment line (`: ping`) every 15 seconds keeps the connection open.

Scope: `sessions:read`.

get.description:
Forward with `after` (oldest first; poll with the returned `last_seq`), or backward with `before` (`latest`, or a `seq`), which returns whole turns. Poll no more than once a second; to follow a running turn, use the stream.

Scope: `sessions:read`.

schema.description: Events with a greater `seq`, oldest first. Default 0.
`latest` for the newest page, or a `seq` for the page before it. Returned oldest first, whole turns only.

get.description:
Server-sent events. Each `transcript` frame is one event, with `id:` set to its `seq`. On connect the stream sends the stored events after `after` (or after the `Last-Event-ID` header), then new events as they arrive. `chat` frames carry the chat when its status changes. An `end` frame closes the stream when the chat is closed or the session is archived or deleted. A comment line (`: ping`) every 15 seconds keeps the connection open.

Scope: `sessions:read`.

schema.description: Start after this `seq`. The `Last-Event-ID` header wins when both are sent.
